evening.caption:
Which element do you want next to you in a crisis? 🛟

In Chinese astrology your element comes from the day you were born. Yang Metal is the raw blade: it decides fast. Yang Earth is the mountain: it doesn't move. Yang Water is the ocean: it always finds another way round. Calm, steady and quick, each in its own way.
